summary: An established Hai Ya venue pairing a Northern Thai khantoke meal with Lanna music and dance. Best approached as an easy, hosted introduction to regional food and performance rather than a museum visit or an intimate local dining experience.
whyGo: Combines a shared meal, traditional music and dance in one evening, with little planning beyond getting there and choosing dietary options.
The venue traces its khantoke dinner to 1971 and presents the format as part of its cultural history.
bestFor: First-time visitors wanting an accessible overview of Lanna performance and food.
Families or groups who enjoy a scheduled dinner show.
skipIf: You prefer a quiet restaurant meal, independent cultural interpretation or a performance without dinner-service bustle.
Floor-level seating or a set-menu format would be uncomfortable; confirm seating options before booking.
duration: Plan about 2 hours at the venue. A current booking listing estimates 1 hour 45 minutes; allow extra time for arrival and transport.
cost: A booking listing currently advertises tickets from ฿690. Treat this as a price reference, not a December 2026 quote; confirm package, dietary-menu and transfer inclusions when booking.
hours: Evening khantoke dinner and performance are advertised. The official site does not show a dependable 2026 daily schedule; confirm show dates and arrival time directly before visiting.
bestTime: Book an evening when you want dinner and cultural entertainment together. Early December may coincide with the venue's annual Chiang Mai Street Jazz Festival, but no 2026 dates or programme were confirmed as of 17 October.
gettingThere: At 185/3 Wua Lai Road, Soi 3, Hai Ya. From central Chiang Mai, use a metered taxi or ride-hailing car; agree the return pickup point in advance. Allow extra time during busy evening traffic.
booking: Reserve through the venue's official website or contact it at +66 95 145 0296 / +66 53 202 992. For December, reconfirm the performance date, start time, menu and transfer arrangements. The official reservation page states cancellation terms vary by notice period.
accessibility: Not clearly documented by the venue. Khantoke dining uses low tables and may involve floor seating; ask about chair seating, step-free access, toilet access and any mobility or hearing needs before paying.
practicalTips: Ask for vegetarian, halal or other dietary arrangements when reserving; menus and availability can change.
Check whether your ticket includes hotel pickup: the venue address is in Hai Ya, away from many central hotels.
Arrive at the time specified by your booking rather than relying on times shown by third-party listings.
decemberNotes: December is busy in Chiang Mai, so reserve ahead and confirm the schedule close to travel. The venue describes its Street Jazz Festival as happening around early December annually; this is not confirmation of a 2026 date, lineup or exact venue arrangements. Its Chiang Mai Food Festival is described as around early January, outside most December visits. Check the official festival page for announcements.
uncertainties: December 2026 dinner-show operating dates, start time, ticket tiers and prices are not published in the sources checked.
The official site gives no clear accessibility information or confirmation of chair seating.
Festival schedule and exact 2026 event locations remain unannounced in the checked official source.
